description: Root application repository encompassing the core backend services, operational maintenance scripts, ingestion audit tooling, and reporting artifacts. The architecture centers around the core application backend, which handles API endpoints, document ingestion, knowledge graph extraction, hybrid vector retrieval, and LLM answer generation. Surrounding utilities include batch maintenance and evaluation scripts, isolated end-to-end ingestion audit tools, and post-ingestion verification reports.

components.name: Core Application Backend
components.description: Implements core API endpoints, document ingestion pipelines, knowledge graph resolution, hybrid retrieval, generation, and catalog storage.

components.name: Retrieval and Query Understanding
components.description: Executes hybrid search, query analysis, graph traversal, and context assembly to support document discovery and question answering.

components.name: Document Ingestion Pipeline
components.description: Ingests, extracts, normalizes, chunks, enriches, and indexes external document content and metadata into search indices.

components.name: Knowledge Graph Extraction
components.description: Extracts entities, claims, and relational predicates from ingested documents to build and verify knowledge graph projections.

components.name: Metadata Catalog Store
components.description: Persists and manages metadata catalog tables, entity indices, assertion states, and document audit records in relational storage.

components.name: Service Endpoints and Orchestration
components.description: Exposes REST API routes, schedules background worker tasks, and coordinates multi-stage query and summarization workflows.

components.name: Infrastructure Clients and Models
components.description: Supplies centralized database, vector index, cache, and LLM client connectors alongside core document and context data schemas.

components.name: Telemetry and Observability Logging
components.description: Captures runtime metrics, traces distributed operations, and logs detailed retrieval telemetry for evaluation and debugging.

components.name: Response Generation and Validation
components.description: Synthesizes grounded LLM responses, evaluates context faithfulness, and formulates followup queries from retrieved evidence.

components.name: Application Configuration and Bootstrap
components.description: Provides system-wide configuration loading, application factory initialization, and service lifecycle management.

components.description: Verifies catalog row counts and checks overall document corpus integrity against expectations.
